sources.chain: blockchain.com charts API, daily values: market-price (USD), difficulty, hash-rate (TH/s), total-bitcoins. Each monthly figure is the mean of the days in that month.
sources.revenue: blockchain.com miners-revenue daily USD (subsidy plus transaction fees), divided by same-day market price, summed over the complete calendar month and divided by its seconds.
sources.subsidy: Bitcoin consensus rule GetBlockSubsidy (50 BTC halved every 210,000 blocks), applied to the supply in the total-bitcoins chart.
sources.efficiency: Cambridge Bitcoin Electricity Consumption Index (CBECI), daily estimated network power demand, divided by the hash-rate chart: joules drawn per terahash. An estimate of the hardware in use, not a chain reading. Average electricity cost assumption: 0.05 USD/kWh.
